items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I knew they had to travel on that like Ma Rainey and Bessie Smith did... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, her voice seemed pretty heavy.

ctx.x: It was right after that. I knew they had to travel on that like Ma Rainey and Bessie Smith did. I never didn't know what happened to Mamie. How did she sound in person? Because her records were so old.
Well, she really sound good during that time. She did really good. She had a number she used to sing, Golf and Papa. Yeah. She really could sing that.
